test_write_avro_buffer: test the polars write_avro function to write a DataFrame to an in-memory buffer with compression
test_read_avro_buffer: test the polars read_avro function to read a DataFrame from an in-memory Avro buffer
test_write_avro_file: test the polars write_avro function to write a DataFrame to an Avro file on disk
test_read_avro_columns: test the polars read_avro function to read only selected columns by name or index from an Avro file
test_write_avro_name: test the polars write_avro function with a custom schema name for the Avro record
